name: Past simple vs. past continuous
note: Past simple for finished actions and the main events of a story (she arrived, opened the door). Past continuous (was/were + -ing) for an action in progress around a past moment, often interrupted by a past simple action (while I was cooking, the phone rang).

questions.q: Did you visit Canada last year?
options: No, I never have been there.

questions.q: "I went to the cinema last night." "So ______ "
A: Janet couldn't come to the concert last night. B: I wish she ______ .
Last week the Prime Minister had to give an important address to an international ______ when he found his speech had disappeared.
questions.fs: Last week the Prime Minister had to give an important address to an international assembly when he found his speech had disappeared.

questions.q: At 10 o'clock yesterday ______ hundreds of people outside.
The candidate ______ many voters when she ran for governor last year.
questions.fs: The candidate impressed many voters when she ran for governor last year.

questions.q: We decided to ______ bed this morning because last night wore us out.
questions.fs: We decided to stay in bed this morning because last night wore us out.

questions.q: Did your brother go to America last year?
options: No, he did never go there.
No, he has never gone there.

questions.q: Last night, I ______ I was calling the police, and today I really did it.
questions.fs: Last night, I dreamed I was calling the police, and today I really did it.

questions.q: Did you hear? James and Beth ______ last week.
questions.fs: Did you hear? James and Beth got married last week.

questions.q: Mike: 'Do you know what I did last night?' Jane: ' ______ '
questions.fs: Mike: 'Do you know what I did last night?' Jane: 'I shrink to think.'

questions.q: Michael: My wife and I bought some great house plants yesterday. Maria: Really? Do you have a lot of sunlight in your house? Michael: No, so we bought some plants that have low light requirements. Question: What kind of plants did Michael buy? ______
options: Plants that need a lot of sunlight
Plants that don't need a lot of sunlight
questions.fs: Michael: My wife and I bought some great house plants yesterday. Maria: Really? Do you have a lot of sunlight in your house? Michael: No, so we bought some plants that have low light requirements. Question: What kind of plants did Michael buy? Plants that don't need a lot of sunlight.
questions.aw: Plants that don't need a lot of sunlight
